    Interface ReplaceableTopologySource

    Topology source contract used by owners that can atomically replace a dataset.

    Example

    async function replace(source: ReplaceableTopologySource, dataset: MapshaperDataset) {
      await source.replaceDataset(dataset);
    }
    interface ReplaceableTopologySource {
        id: string;
        type: "topology";
        export(options: ExportOptions): Promise<Blob>;
        fire<T = Record<string, unknown>>(type: string, data?: T): this;
        getArcs(): ReadonlyArcCollection | undefined;
        getCRS?(): string;
        getDataset(): ReadonlyMapshaperDataset | undefined;
        getExtent(): Bounds;
        getLayers(): readonly ReadonlyMapshaperLayer[];
        off<T = Record<string, unknown>>(
            type: string,
            listener: EventListener<T>,
        ): this;
        on<T = Record<string, unknown>>(
            type: string,
            listener: EventListener<T>,
        ): this;
        once<T = Record<string, unknown>>(
            type: string,
            listener: EventListener<T>,
        ): this;
        replaceDataset(dataset: MapshaperDataset): Promise<void>;
    }

    export

    • export(options: ExportOptions): Promise<Blob>

      Serialize the current in-memory dataset to a browser Blob.

      Always emits full-detail geometry; the source's render-time LOD interval is restored before the promise resolves.

      • geojson / topojson — single-file output, returned as application/json
      • shapefile — multi-file output (.shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj), returned as a single application/zip Blob packed via fflate

    getDataset

    • getDataset(): ReadonlyMapshaperDataset | undefined

      Returns a zero-copy, deep read-only TypeScript view of the live dataset.

      The view intentionally omits mutating ArcCollection methods and marks nested layers, shapes, records and metadata as read-only. Route changes through Emap.ops.*, Emap.editSession.* or an EditCommand so render caches, selection and history stay synchronized.

      This is a compile-time boundary, not a runtime clone: JavaScript, any and explicit type assertions can still bypass it.

      Returns ReadonlyMapshaperDataset | undefined

      Inherited from ITopologySource.getDataset

      • Defined in src/source/source.ts:59
